artworks.title: Painting the Lengua Chief
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The painting depicts a serene village scene near a body of water with trees and thatched structures on the horizon. Small figures are dispersed throughout the landscape, with some people near a canoe on the water's edge and others gathered in the open ground. The color palette includes earthy browns, greens, and soft sky tones, creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Shore of the Uruguay - Making a Sketch
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a scene looking out across a body of water. The horizon is formed where the river meets dense foliage. The brushstrokes in the painting are smooth and slightly impressionistic. The color palette is dominated by varying shades of green, with dashes of earthy brown and pale blue-gray. A narrow wooden boat with two figures is positioned on the calm river. The riverbank is rich with vegetation, extending into the background.

artworks.title: Lengua Indians Ascending the Rapids of the Rio Uruguay
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene within an oval boundary. The horizon is slightly above the painting's center, obscured by tall trees and vegetation. The brushstrokes are soft, creating a textured look for the foliage. The color palette includes earthy tones dominated by greens, browns, and deep reds. In the foreground, there is a narrow canoe with figures inside, and on the riverbank, more figures are pulling something with a rope. The background shows a dense forest.

artworks.title: A Small Lengua Village
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a riverine landscape viewed from above. The horizon is high in the image, with the sky blending warm tones and the sun shining softly. The scene features a mix of pastel colors, including blues, pinks, and light greens. Groups of people gather on a hill near the river, interacting with each other. A canoe is seen on the riverbank with people onboard. The overall color scheme includes earthy tones blending harmoniously with the water. Palms and other trees populate the area, adding to the idyllic atmosphere.

artworks.title: A Small Lengua Village, Uruguay
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with lush greenery and tall trees. There is a body of water in the foreground with people in canoes. In the background, figures are near huts on a hill. The scene is depicted in soft brushstrokes with earthy tones of green and brown, creating a tranquil atmosphere. The horizon is high, showing a distant sky above the trees.

artworks.title: A Small Village - Payaguas Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape framed in an oval shape, depicting a river scene. People and canoes are near the river, engaging in activities like fishing and paddling. Grassy banks lead to a settlement area where groups of people are gathered near simple structures. Tall trees form a canopy above the settlement. The brushstrokes are detailed, creating texture in the foliage and terrain. The color palette is earthy, with greens, yellows, browns, and blues dominating the scene. Taller trees reach into the sky in the background, completing the view.

artworks.title: A Small Village of Remos Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a pastoral setting seen from a slightly elevated perspective. Greenery meets a pastel-colored sky near the horizon in the upper third of the composition. A line of trees with various foliage appears at the horizon, including tall palm trees silhouetted against the sky. The brushwork is delicate and detailed, capturing natural elements with a light touch. In the foreground, a field with small plants and flowers is depicted with intricate brushstrokes. Simple structures with thatched roofs are nestled within the greenery. The color palette includes soft greens, warm earth tones, and gentle sky pastels. The frame around the painting complements the landscape.

artworks.title: A Sepibo Village
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image is viewed from an elevated perspective, showing a scene with a low horizon. Huts are nestled in a lush, green wooded area. Brushstrokes are smooth, capturing the density of trees and foliage. The color palette is warm and earthy, with greens, browns, and soft sky blue. A group of figures is gathered in the foreground. Trees rise behind them, with a dense vegetation framing the scene.

artworks.title: Mouth of the Rio Purus
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a body of water with a boat in the foreground and lush greenery in the background. The sky above is painted in shades of gray and blue with soft clouds. The overall color scheme is made up of cool blues, greens, and browns.

artworks.title: Halting to Make a Sketch
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a scene viewed from an elevated point through an oval window. The horizon is in the upper part, with a dense wall of greenery made up of lush trees and palms. The foliage is vibrant with various shades of green, while the sky above displays soft blues and gentle grays. In the foreground, multiple figures are engaging in an activity on open land, with some animals present. The painting features fine brushstrokes, detailing plants and figures for a realistic effect within a controlled space. The color palette includes natural greens, earth tones, and occasional touches of bright reds within the foliage, creating a serene visual impact.

artworks.title: A Connibo Wigwam
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a scene of daily life from an observational point of view. The horizon is positioned just above the middle of the composition, with dense green foliage stretching across the image. The brushstrokes are soft, creating a smooth texture in the sky, trees, and leaves. The color palette is earthy and muted, with greens, browns, soft blues, and grays dominating. In the foreground, a group of individuals is engaged in an activity, with some near a modest structure with a sloped roof on the left side.

artworks.title: Pacapacurus Village
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with traditional thatched-roof huts on a yellow plain. There is a line of greenery and trees on the horizon. The brushstrokes are soft, and the color palette includes earthy greens, yellows, blues, and pinks. In the distance, a figure is near the huts.

artworks.title: Spearing by Torchlight
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a night-time riverscape with a view from the bank of a river. The horizon is in the upper third of the painting, where the river meets a line of trees fading into the night. The brushstrokes give an impressionistic texture to the foliage and water, creating movement and depth. The color palette consists of deep blues and blacks, with a red-orange glow near a light source by the river bank illuminating nearby vegetation. A canoe with figures moves on the water near the light, heading towards the dim shorelines. Dark clouds loom in the upper portion, emphasizing the nocturnal setting.

artworks.title: Chief and Members of the Konza Tribe
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a group of five individuals - four standing and one seated in the foreground. The standing individuals have varied hand positions; two hold long pipes, and one appears to hold a bow and arrow. The seated individual is on the ground with a child beside her. The group has detailed facial features, with the men wearing plumed headdresses and the women adorned with beads and traditional clothing. The men have styled hair with adornments and wear cloaks, garments with patterns and beadwork, and moccasins. The seated woman wears a patterned garment, arm jewelry, and bead necklaces. The background is a light, textured painting suggestive of a natural environment, surrounded by a green frame with wear and a "37" label at the top.

artworks.title: Indians and Horses in the Forest
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with lush trees and vegetation. Several figures engage in daily activities, while horses graze nearby. The brushstrokes are detailed, and the color palette consists of natural tones with hints of red.

artworks.title: Omaha Chief, His Wife, and a Warrior
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing in a line. The person on the left has long dark hair, wears a light-colored, fringed garment with bead embellishments, and holds a feathered fan. The middle figure wears an elaborate headdress with feathers, a fringed garment with bead patterns, and holds a staff or spear adorned with feathers. The individual on the right has long dark hair, wears a fringed garment with beadwork, holds a wooden pipe, and carries a fringed, beaded bag. The background has a light-colored gradient, with the figures standing on grass, framed by a border with the number "21" at the top.

artworks.title: Black Hawk and the Prophet - Saukie
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals, each depicted in full-length form. Two individuals are standing on the left side. One has crossed arms, and the other is holding a staff. In the center, a seated individual holds a staff with feathers, looking towards another individual who is gesturing with one hand extended. The individual on the far right stands with a shawl draped over one shoulder. All five have distinctive hair styles with orange and black feathered extensions. They wear garments with fringes, vibrant patterns, and beads or necklaces. The background features a softly colored sky and hints of earth tones, suggesting a natural landscape with no distinct landmarks visible.

artworks.title: War Dance of the Apachees
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a large gathering encircling an open area from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is high with natural land, distant trees, and some structures under a soft sky. Teepees and thatched structures are on the left with figures engaging in a communal event. Movements of people in circular formations dominate the open space. Brushstrokes are detailed and precise, capturing the complexity of the gathering and landscape texture. The color palette includes earthy tones of browns and greens with subdued blues, creating a serene yet lively scene with warm cultural nuance.

artworks.title: The Expedition Leaving Fort Frontenac on Lake Ontario.  November 18, 1678
artworks.medium: oil on canvas
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a shoreline with people in colorful clothing on the sandy shore. In the sea, there are small and larger vessels, the latter with a dark sail and people on board. The horizon meets the sea, blending with the sky above, which has a gradient of pinks and blues with clouds. The brushstrokes are smooth, detailing the scene. The color palette includes green, ochre, and blue-green tones for the land, sand, sea, and sky. The background shows structures and greenery along the coast.

artworks.title: The Expedition Encamped below the Falls of Niagara.  January 20, 1679
artworks.medium: oil on canvas
artworks.description: The image shows a winter scene with an icy river and activity on the shore. A rocky cliff partially covered in snow is on the right, with evergreen trees. On the left, the river flows towards a distant waterfall, creating a natural division. The horizon is low, emphasizing the surrounding cliffs and the waterfall. The artwork has smooth brushstrokes for the water and sky, while rocks and trees are more textured. The color palette is mainly cool tones of blues and whites for the icy landscape, with earth tones in the cliffs and figures. People on the shore are engaged in various activities, with boats and tents nearby.

artworks.title: Portage Around the Falls of Niagara at Table Rock
artworks.medium: oil on canvas
artworks.description: The painting depicts an elevated viewpoint of a grand waterfall surrounded by a landscape filled with people and canoes. The horizon is high in the composition, marked by a line of trees and the flowing waterfall. Delicate yet expressive brushstrokes capture the water's motion, trees, and people. The color palette is vivid and cool, with blues for the sky and water, and earth tones for people and canoes. A mist rises from the waterfall's base, merging with soft clouds in the sky. The scene suggests a winter atmosphere, with touches of white indicating snow on the ground and vegetation.

artworks.title: La Salle Driving the First Bolt for the Griffin.  January 26, 1679
artworks.medium: oil on canvas
artworks.description: The image shows a shoreline with people engaged in various activities. The horizon is in the upper third of the image, with the water meeting the sky. Along the shoreline, there are people and groups, some standing and others active. Trees are present with a hint of snow on them. The color palette includes earth tones, pale blues, and splashes of red. The brushwork is detailed yet loose, capturing the lively atmosphere near the water.

artworks.title: Returning to Fort Frontenac by Sled.  February 1679
artworks.medium: oil on canvas
artworks.description: The painting depicts a winter scene with an elevated perspective, showing a snow-covered landscape. The horizon is high with snow-covered trees blending into a pastel sky. The ground is covered in snow with streaks of green and brown. Snow-covered trees extend from the foreground to the horizon. Two figures with dogs on a sled can be seen in the distance. The brushstrokes are loose, capturing the snow texture, figure movement, and foliage. The color palette is cool and earthy with soft greens, whites, and browns, complemented by muted sky tones.

artworks.title: Launching of the Griffin.  July 1679
artworks.medium: oil on canvas
artworks.description: The image shows a gathering of indigenous people along a waterway, with a large boat being maneuvered ashore. People on land and in canoes are raising their arms towards the boat. In the background, a crowd lines the shore, with a forest and sky in soft pink and gray hues. The style is characterized by detailed brushstrokes capturing textures and motion, with a vibrant natural color palette.
